title: Jealousy
lyrics:
[00:10] Jealousy is killin' me, it's too much to dismiss
[00:15] I don't wanna die, but I don't wanna live like this
[00:20] Honestly, I'd rather be asleep, not feel a thing
[00:25] I don't like how it goes, but I still go there, I'll admit
[00:35] And baby, it's hard to see a way out
[00:40] Compare myself to many men
[00:45] Many nights spent hating on them
[00:50] Ooh-ooh-ooh, now and then, I'm alright, in the end
[00:55] When misery is running me and ruling how I feel
[01:00] I'm not satisfied, I need a change of pace for real
[01:05] I'm on my feet, I'm semi-clean
[01:08] I'm miles from where I've been
[01:11] I'm missing you tonight, I hope you're cozy in the sheets
[01:16] But girl, when I act like this, it isn't fair, no
[01:20] You know I do it when I'm feeling scared
[01:23] Baby, I'm stressing out, pulling out my hair, yeah
[01:27] And I'm imaginin' the worst
[01:30] But the worst never comes, I'm aware
[01:35] I hope you're sleeping well, I do
[01:38] I hope you're sleeping well, oh
[01:41] I hope you're sleeping well over there
[01:45] I'm thinking of you, hoping you're in peace
[01:49] Hope you know, just how much I care
[01:54] I really hope you're sleeping well
[01:58] I'm excited just for waking up and to see, how your night sleep was
[02:04] Breakfast, dawn, I stretch and yawn
[02:08] I'll start the day by texting you, "Good morning babe, how you feeling?"
[02:14] I wish that I had woken next to you, but either way
[02:19] I'm happy just to see your name, appearing on my phone
[02:24] I get that feeling once again, and then my smile starts to grow
[02:29] Now I'm thinking through what to say
[02:32] Yeah, I get jealous as fuck, and no, it doesn't feel great
[02:37] But I'm still with you and that's all I that can know right now, hey
[02:42] Tomorrow might not be here
[02:45] I swear that I can make a change
[02:49] Why waste the time we have my dear? I'll make a change
[02:53] No need for jealousy today
[02:57] I hope you sleep well, my babe
[03:05] Goodnight
